summary_en: Develops focused-ultrasound-based acoustic holography that combines a concave transducer with holographic phase modulation to generate complex multifocal acoustic fields. The method exploits convergence-driven field scaling and self-interference to achieve sub-millimeter trapping features, and is demonstrated for multilayer cell patterning and biomimetic tissue-model construction.
